name: kiss
description: Prevent over-engineering and unnecessary complexity. Use when the agent is about to introduce abstractions, helpers, layers, design patterns, or multi-step workflows for something that could be solved simply. Triggers on: over-engineering, unnecessarily complex solution, unnecessary abstraction, add a helper, create a utility, refactor into a class, generalize this, make it reusable, create a wrapper, introduce a pattern, complex implementation, elaborate solution.
author: danielstegeman
